footerNote: Free tools that speak your language.

common.extras: Monthly average of overtime, commissions and allowances (R$)
common.extrasHint: Counted in vacation, 13th salary and termination pay.

net.disclaimer: Simulation with the 2026 tables. It does not replace your official payslip or advice from an accountant.

rescisao.avisoIndenizado: Notice period paid in lieu (paid without working it)
rescisao.avisoNaoCumprido: I won't work my notice period (the employer may deduct 30 days)
rescisao.fgtsHint: See it in the FGTS app. If you leave it blank, we estimate it from your time at the company.
rescisao.fgtsNoWithdraw: With this type of termination you can't withdraw your FGTS.
rescisao.seguro: You can apply for unemployment insurance (seguro-desemprego) if you meet the work-time requirements.
rescisao.noSeguro: This type of termination does not give unemployment insurance.
rescisao.disclaimer: Simulation with the CLT rules and the 2026 tables. The employer must pay within 10 days after the contract ends (art. 477). Check with your union or an employment lawyer.

ferias.absences: Unexcused absences in the accrual period
ferias.soldHint: You can sell up to 1/3 of your vacation: 10 days out of 30.
ferias.reduction: Apply the 2026 income tax reduction to vacation pay
ferias.disclaimer: Simulation. The sold days and their 1/3 bonus are free of INSS and income tax. The employer must pay up to 2 days before your vacation starts (art. 145).

decimo.monthsHint: A month counts if you worked 15 days or more in it.
decimo.disclaimer: The 1st installment has no deductions. INSS and income tax are taken from the 2nd installment, on the whole 13th salary.

horas.pctHint: At least 50%. Check whether your union agreement sets more.
horas.night: Hours worked between 10 pm and 5 am
horas.nightHint: In clock hours; each night hour counts as 52 min 30 s.
horas.restDays: Sundays and holidays in the month
horas.disclaimer: Gross amounts. INSS and income tax are charged on them together with the month's salary.

proporcional.weeks: Weeks with an absence (lose the paid rest day)
proporcional.disclaimer: Gross amount, before INSS and income tax.

photo.dragHint: Drag the photo to center the face.
photo.privacy: Your photo never leaves your device: everything happens in your browser.
photo.printNote: Print at actual size (100%), without “fit to page”.
photo.error: Couldn't open the image. Try a JPG or PNG.

pdf.privacy: Your file never leaves your device: everything happens in your browser.
pdf.note: To reduce the size, each page becomes an image. The text can no longer be selected or copied.
pdf.already: Your PDF is already smaller than the size you chose.
pdf.tooBig: Couldn't reach that size without making the text unreadable. This is the smallest readable result.
pdf.error: Couldn't open the PDF. It may be damaged or password-protected.

merge.privacy: Your files never leave your device: everything happens in your browser.
merge.error: Couldn't open one of the files. It may be password-protected.
merge.images: JPG and PNG photos work too: each one becomes a page.

chrome.themeToggle: Switch between light and dark theme

consent.title: We use cookies
consent.text: Necessary cookies remember your theme, your language and this choice. With your permission, Google also uses cookies to measure visits and personalise ads. You can change your choice at any time from the bottom of the page.
consent.necessaryDesc: Remember your theme, your language and your cookie choice.
consent.analyticsDesc: Help us see which tools are used most (Google Analytics).
consent.adsDesc: Lets Google show ads based on your interests. If you reject it, you'll see non-personalised ads.
